agents.name: Chief of Staff
agents.task: Assign work and resolve stalled handoffs.
agents.deliverable: Cycle report, coverage gaps and priority queue.

agents.name: Approval Coordinator
agents.task: Prepare a complete decision packet for ME.
agents.deliverable: Verified review request and email notification; preserve pending items.

agents.name: Source Verifier
agents.task: Read official notices, attachments and amendments.
agents.deliverable: Verified buyer, deadline, source links and contact permission.

agents.name: Eligibility Analyst
agents.task: Compare mandatory requirements to ProcessPilot evidence.
agents.deliverable: Eligibility decision, curable gaps and missing evidence.

agents.name: Bid Decision Analyst
agents.task: Assess strategic fit, delivery capacity, deadlines and risk.
agents.deliverable: Bid recommendation with reasoning; unknown price is not a rejection.

agents.name: Requirements Analyst
agents.task: Extract every response requirement and submission rule.
agents.deliverable: Compliance matrix, required forms and document checklist.

agents.name: Proposal Manager
agents.task: Plan milestones, owners and the response structure.
agents.deliverable: Response plan and outstanding dependencies.

agents.name: Solution Architect
agents.task: Design an evidence-supported technical approach.
agents.deliverable: Architecture, work plan, security and implementation narrative.

agents.name: Proposal Writer
agents.task: Write solicitation-specific responses grounded in company evidence.
agents.deliverable: Draft proposal sections with requirement cross-references.

agents.name: Document Producer
agents.task: Draft missing response documents and mark evidence gaps.
agents.deliverable: Cover letters, plans, questionnaires, matrices and required-form drafts.

agents.name: Pricing & Compliance
agents.task: Review internal cost assumptions and response compliance.
agents.deliverable: Internal pricing model and compliance correction list.

agents.name: Outreach & Submission
agents.task: Verify recipients, send permitted introductions and assemble submissions.
agents.deliverable: Email IDs, draft IDs and complete package for ME's approval.
